name: NewInterfaceDialog
intent: Author a shared ontology interface: name, description, status and what it extends.
when: Declaring a contract several object types will implement
Any create flow over a named, extendable type
whenNot: Adding a property shared across types -> use NewSharedPropertyDialog
Grouping types for navigation -> use NewTypeGroupDialog

chooseOver.because: It offers the Extends picker and can enforce the description rule, which is the difference between an interface and a name.

requireDescription.note: Enforce the best-practice description rule. Default false, so existing hosts are unchanged.

dataContract.rowIdentity: Drafts carry no id; the host mints one on accept.

states.default: Name and API name, status at its default.
states.extending: One or more parent interfaces chosen.
states.strict: With requireDescription, creation is refused until a description is given.

evaluationCriteria: requireDescription defaults false so existing hosts do not change behaviour.

lineage.authoredBy: Promoted in group C of the missing-widgets template review (2026-08-26)
notes: Its own comment records that it reproduces a private NewInterfaceDialog from a since-removed fork — exactly the duplication this promotion prevents.
Already an exported component with a typed props interface and no fixture coupling — this manifest is the only thing that was missing.
